declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.padExtrema
declarations.source_header: def padExtrema (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) : List α

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.padExtrema_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem padExtrema_length (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    (padExtrema low high lo hi xs).length = low + xs.length + high

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.padding_length_identity
declarations.source_header:
theorem padding_length_identity (k n : Nat) :
    (n - 1 - 2 * k) + n + (2 * k + 1 - n) =
      2 * (k + (n - 1 - 2 * k)) + 1

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.padding_total_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem padding_total_le (k n : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    (n - 1 - 2 * k) + (2 * k + 1 - n) ≤ n - 1

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.extrema
declarations.source_header: def extrema (x : α) (xs : List α) : α × α

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.extrema_spec
declarations.source_header:
theorem extrema_spec (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    ((extrema x xs).1 ∈ x :: xs ∧ ∀ y ∈ x :: xs, (extrema x xs).1 ≤ y) ∧
      ((extrema x xs).2 ∈ x :: xs ∧ ∀ y ∈ x :: xs, y ≤ (extrema x xs).2)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.extrema_eq_of_bounds
declarations.source_header:
theorem extrema_eq_of_bounds (x : α) (xs : List α) (lo hi : α)
    (hlo_mem : lo ∈ x :: xs) (hhi_mem : hi ∈ x :: xs)
    (hlo : ∀ y ∈ x :: xs, lo ≤ y) (hhi : ∀ y ∈ x :: xs, y ≤ hi) :
    extrema x xs = (lo, hi)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.ranked_padExtrema
declarations.source_header:
theorem ranked_padExtrema (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) (k : Nat)
    (a : α) (ha : RankedAt xs k a) (hlo : lo ≤ a) (hhi : a ≤ hi) :
    RankedAt (padExtrema low high lo hi xs) (k + low) a

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian
declarations.source_header: def reduceToMedian (k : Nat) : List α → List α

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_nil
declarations.source_header: theorem reduceToMedian_nil (k : Nat) : reduceToMedian k ([] : List α) = []

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_length (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (reduceToMedian k xs).length =
      (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k) + xs.length + (2 * k + 1 - xs.length)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_nonempty
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_nonempty (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    reduceToMedian k xs ≠ []

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_length_eq
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_length_eq (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (reduceToMedian k xs).length = 2 * (k + (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k)) + 1

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_center
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_center (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    ((reduceToMedian k xs).length - 1) / 2 = k + (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_odd
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_odd (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (reduceToMedian k xs).length % 2 = 1

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_length_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_length_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (reduceToMedian k xs).length ≤ 2 * xs.length - 1

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_rank_shift
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_rank_shift (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α)
    (ha : RankedAt xs k a) :
    RankedAt (reduceToMedian k xs) (k + (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k)) a

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_ranked
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_ranked (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α)
    (ha : RankedAt xs k a) :
    RankedAt (reduceToMedian k xs) (((reduceToMedian k xs).length - 1) / 2) a

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_value (choose : List α → Option α) (hv : PivotValid choose)
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    lowerMedianWith choose (reduceToMedian k xs) = selectFixed k xs

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_payload_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_payload_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hx : xs ≠ []) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    some (lowerMedianValue (reduceToMedian k xs) (reduceToMedian_nonempty k xs hx)) =
      selectFixed k xs

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.MedianReduction.reduceToMedian_spec
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedian_spec (choose : List α → Option α) (hv : PivotValid choose)
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    reduceToMedian k xs ≠ [] ∧
      lowerMedianWith choose (reduceToMedian k xs) = selectWith choose (k + 1) xs

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.replicateRun
declarations.source_header: def replicateRun (a : α) : Nat → Measured (List α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.replicateRun_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem replicateRun_exact (a : α) (n : Nat) :
    replicateRun a n = (List.replicate n a, n + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.padExtremaRun
declarations.source_header:
def padExtremaRun (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    Measured (List α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.padExtremaRun_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem padExtremaRun_value (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    (padExtremaRun low high lo hi xs).1 = padExtrema low high lo hi xs

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.padExtremaRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem padExtremaRun_cost (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    (padExtremaRun low high lo hi xs).2 = 2 * low + high + xs.length + 5

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.padExtremaRun_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem padExtremaRun_exact (low high : Nat) (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    padExtremaRun low high lo hi xs =
      (padExtrema low high lo hi xs, 2 * low + high + xs.length + 5)

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.extremaRun
declarations.source_header: def extremaRun (x : α) (xs : List α) : Measured (α × α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.extremaRun_value
declarations.source_header: theorem extremaRun_value (x : α) (xs : List α) : (extremaRun x xs).1 = extrema x xs

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.extremaRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem extremaRun_cost (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (extremaRun x xs).2 = 2 * xs.length + 3

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.extremaRun_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem extremaRun_exact (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    extremaRun x xs = (extrema x xs, 2 * xs.length + 3)

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun
declarations.source_header: def reduceToMedianRun (k : Nat) : List α → Measured (List α) Nat

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_nil
declarations.source_header: theorem reduceToMedianRun_nil (k : Nat) : reduceToMedianRun k ([] : List α) = ([], 1)

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedianRun_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (reduceToMedianRun k xs).1 = reduceToMedian k xs

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_cons_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedianRun_cons_cost (k : Nat) (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (reduceToMedianRun k (x :: xs)).2 =
      4 * (x :: xs).length + 2 * ((x :: xs).length - 1 - 2 * k) +
        (2 * k + 1 - (x :: xs).length) + 8

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedianRun_cost (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (reduceToMedianRun k xs).2 =
      4 * xs.length + 2 * (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k) + (2 * k + 1 - xs.length) + 8

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_cost_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedianRun_cost_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (reduceToMedianRun k xs).2 ≤ 6 * xs.length + 6

declarations.name: Resources.MedianReduction.reduceToMedianRun_uniform_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduceToMedianRun_uniform_bound :
    ∃ C1 C2 : Nat, ∀ (k : Nat) (xs : List α), k < xs.length →
      (reduceToMedianRun k xs).2 ≤ C1 * xs.length + C2

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.extrema_mixed
declarations.source_header: theorem extrema_mixed : extrema (4 : Nat) [1, 7, 1] = (1, 7)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.extrema_tied
declarations.source_header: theorem extrema_tied : extrema (3 : Nat) [3, 3] = (3, 3)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.extrema_integer
declarations.source_header: theorem extrema_integer : extrema (-2 : Int) [7, -2, 0] = (-2, 7)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.extrema_execution
declarations.source_header: theorem extrema_execution : extremaRun (4 : Nat) [1, 7, 1] = ((1, 7), 9)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.replication_execution
declarations.source_header: theorem replication_execution : replicateRun (5 : Int) 3 = ([5, 5, 5], 4)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.tied_padding_rank
declarations.source_header: theorem tied_padding_rank : RankedAt (padExtrema 2 3 (1 : Nat) 1 [1, 1]) 3 1

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.first_padding
declarations.source_header:
theorem first_padding :
    reduceToMedian 0 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = [1, 1, 1, 4, 1, 7, 1]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.last_padding
declarations.source_header:
theorem last_padding :
    reduceToMedian 3 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = [4, 1, 7, 1, 7, 7, 7]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.lower_middle_padding
declarations.source_header:
theorem lower_middle_padding :
    reduceToMedian 1 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = [1, 4, 1, 7, 1]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.upper_middle_padding
declarations.source_header:
theorem upper_middle_padding :
    reduceToMedian 2 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = [4, 1, 7, 1, 7]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.already_central
declarations.source_header: theorem already_central : reduceToMedian 1 ([4, 1, 1] : List Nat) = [4, 1, 1]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.singleton_unchanged
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_unchanged {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) :
    reduceToMedian 0 [x] = [x]

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.empty_median_failure
declarations.source_header:
theorem empty_median_failure (k : Nat) :
    lowerMedianWith List.head? (reduceToMedian k ([] : List Nat)) = none

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.lower_middle_median
declarations.source_header:
theorem lower_middle_median :
    lowerMedianWith lastPivot (reduceToMedian 1 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat)) = some 1

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.upper_middle_payload
declarations.source_header:
theorem upper_middle_payload :
    lowerMedianValue (reduceToMedian 2 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat))
      (reduceToMedian_nonempty 2 _ (by decide)) = 4

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.reduction_shape
declarations.source_header:
theorem reduction_shape {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (k : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hk : k < xs.length) :
    reduceToMedian k xs ≠ [] ∧ (reduceToMedian k xs).length % 2 = 1 ∧
      (reduceToMedian k xs).length ≤ 2 * xs.length - 1 ∧
      ((reduceToMedian k xs).length - 1) / 2 = k + (xs.length - 1 - 2 * k)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.padding_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem padding_execution :
    padExtremaRun 3 0 (1 : Nat) 7 [4, 1, 7, 1] = ([1, 1, 1, 4, 1, 7, 1], 15)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.first_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem first_execution :
    reduceToMedianRun 0 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = ([1, 1, 1, 4, 1, 7, 1], 30)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.last_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem last_execution :
    reduceToMedianRun 3 ([4, 1, 7, 1] : List Nat) = ([4, 1, 7, 1, 7, 7, 7], 27)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.central_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem central_execution :
    reduceToMedianRun 1 ([4, 1, 1] : List Nat) = ([4, 1, 1], 20)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.singleton_execution
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_execution {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (x : α) :
    reduceToMedianRun 0 [x] = ([x], 12)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.empty_execution
declarations.source_header: theorem empty_execution (k : Nat) : reduceToMedianRun k ([] : List Nat) = ([], 1)

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.first_rank_attains_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem first_rank_attains_bound {α : Type} [LinearOrder α] (xs : List α)
    (hx : xs ≠ []) : (reduceToMedianRun 0 xs).2 = 6 * xs.length + 6

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.measured_reduction_contract
declarations.source_header:
theorem measured_reduction_contract {α : Type} [LinearOrder α]
    (choose : List α → Option α) (hv : PivotValid choose) (k : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (reduceToMedianRun k xs).1 ≠ [] ∧
      lowerMedianWith choose (reduceToMedianRun k xs).1 = selectWith choose (k + 1) xs ∧
      (reduceToMedianRun k xs).2 ≤ 6 * xs.length + 6

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.invalid_rank_values
declarations.source_header:
theorem invalid_rank_values :
    lowerMedianWith List.head? (reduceToMedian 1 ([7] : List Nat)) = some 7 ∧
      selectFixed 1 ([7] : List Nat) = none

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.invalid_rank_cost_exceeds_valid_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem invalid_rank_cost_exceeds_valid_bound :
    6 * ([7] : List Nat).length + 6 < (reduceToMedianRun 1 ([7] : List Nat)).2

declarations.name: Examples.MedianReduction.uniform_reduction_constants
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniform_reduction_constants :
    ∃ C1 C2 : Nat, ∀ (k : Nat) (xs : List Nat), k < xs.length →
      (reduceToMedianRun k xs).2 ≤ C1 * xs.length + C2
